full_page.content:
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
c.1945
/POST CARD/
St. Michaels Monastery 225 Jerome Street Brooklyn, 7, N.Y.
Mrs. Alice Plunkett Apt. 215 11 Moss Ave. Highland Park Michigan
God bless you Mrs. Plunkett - you and yours,
You've been on my mind frequently these days. I wanted to write you but getting aquainted in a new place keeps one on edge pretty much.
I inscribed the names you sent me recently thru Rae Garland and I am surely pleased to know your able to keep up the good work. Thanks be to God. The above Monastery is where I made my annual retreat last week. It is across the Hudson from Lady Cliff convent and West Point Military College - the latter about a mile and a half up. Thank God it is quite an ideal place for quiet reflection and study. About 75 priests, Clerics and lay brothers, ...
God bless you again and keep well ...
Fr. Solanus O.F.M. Cap.
Note: Above postcard was of Mary Immaculate Friary, Garrison, N.Y.
Original in Possession of: Miss Esther Plunkett
20505 Charleston
Detroit, Michigan 48203
